alias.en: The stomach muscles work slowly, so food leaves the stomach late
alias.zh: 胃肌肉蠕动变慢，食物迟迟离不开胃
alias.ms: Otot perut bergerak perlahan, jadi makanan lambat meninggalkan perut

lead.en: The stomach muscles do not squeeze food along as they should, even though nothing is blocking it, so you may feel full and sick.
lead.zh: 胃肌肉没有正常推动食物前进，虽然并没有东西堵住，所以会觉得饱胀和恶心。
lead.ms: Otot perut tidak menolak makanan seperti biasa walaupun tiada apa yang menyekat, jadi anda mungkin rasa penuh dan mual.

v.en: People with diabetes; also after stomach surgery or a virus
v.zh: 糖尿病患者；也见于胃部手术或病毒感染之后
v.ms: Pesakit diabetes; juga selepas pembedahan perut atau jangkitan virus

v.en: Often long-lasting but can be managed with a doctor's help
v.zh: 常常持续很久，但在医生帮助下可以控制
v.ms: Selalunya berpanjangan tetapi boleh diurus dengan bantuan doktor

c.en: High blood sugar or blood pressure
A side effect of some medicines
The cause is not fully known

h.zh: 出现这些情况请先看医生

li.en: Vomiting blood or black stools: go to hospital now
li.zh: 呕血或排黑便：立即去医院
li.ms: Muntah darah atau najis hitam: ke hospital segera

li.en: Severe belly pain or a hard, swollen belly
li.zh: 剧烈腹痛，或肚子又硬又胀
li.ms: Sakit perut yang teruk atau perut keras dan bengkak

li.en: Vomiting again and again, or cannot keep drinks down
li.zh: 反复呕吐，或喝水也吐出来
li.ms: Muntah berulang-ulang, atau tidak dapat menahan minuman

li.en: Dehydration: very dry mouth, dizzy, very little urine
li.zh: 脱水：口很干、头晕、尿很少
li.ms: Dehidrasi: mulut sangat kering, pening, air kencing sangat sedikit

li.en: Losing weight, or blood sugar that is hard to control
li.zh: 体重下降，或血糖很难控制
li.ms: Berat badan turun, atau gula darah sukar dikawal

p.en: If any apply, please see a doctor before a session.
p.zh: 如果有以上情况，请先看医生，再来做调理。
p.ms: Jika mana-mana berkenaan, sila jumpa doktor sebelum sesi.

p.en: This page is general information. Please keep taking your normal medicine and keep seeing your doctor.
p.zh: 本页只是一般性的健康资讯。请继续按时服用平常的药物，并继续看医生。
p.ms: Halaman ini ialah maklumat am. Sila terus mengambil ubat biasa anda dan terus berjumpa doktor.

h.en: More ways to look after yourself

li.en: Choose soft, low-fat foods and chew well
li.zh: 选择柔软、低脂的食物，并细嚼慢咽
li.ms: Pilih makanan lembut dan rendah lemak serta kunyah dengan baik

li.en: Keep blood sugar steady with your doctor's advice
li.zh: 遵照医生的建议稳定血糖
li.ms: Kekalkan gula darah stabil mengikut nasihat doktor anda

tell.en: Diabetes or less feeling in the skin
tell.zh: 糖尿病或皮肤感觉减退

refs: General information based on public health sources such as Mayo Clinic, NHS, Cleveland Clinic and NCBI StatPearls.
